ideas.title: Investigating the Minnesota ICE Shooting
ideas.description: This story would investigate the circumstances surrounding the Minnesota ICE shooting incident and the subsequent investigation.
ideas.angle: Use of force by ICE officers
questions: What were the circumstances leading up to the shooting?
What is the current status of the investigation?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover systemic issues with ICE's use of force and the need for greater transparency and accountability. By following the money and investigating the incident, we may uncover a larger pattern of misconduct.

ideas.title: Uncovering Revenue Diversion in Local Government
ideas.description: This story would investigate the revenue diversion activities in the City of Florence and potential similar cases in other local governments.
questions: What is the extent of the revenue diversion in the City of Florence?
Are there similar cases in other local governments?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover a larger pattern of financial mismanagement in local government. By analyzing data and investigating similar cases, we may identify a systemic issue that requires attention and reform.
